desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure and Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and in compliance with the various circulars issued by Ministry of Corporate Affairs, please find enclosed copies of newspaper advertisement published in Financial Express (English and Gujarati) editions on 22nd August, 2026, related to dispatch of the notice of the  36th AGM of the company to be held on Monday, 21st September, 2026 through VC/OAVM to the shareholders.

Pursuant to Regulation 34 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby submit the Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the Notice of the 36th Annual General Meeting of the company to be held on Monday, 21st September, 2026 at 12.00 P.M. through Video Conferencing/Other Audio-Visual Means, which is being sent to members through electronic means. 

The Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with notice of the AGM will be available on the website of the company i.e., www.mazdalimited.com. 

Please take note of the same.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 & 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure and Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and in compliance with various circulars issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, please find enclosed copies of newspaper advertisement published in Financial Express (English and Gujarati) editions related to the 36th Annual General Meeting of the company to be held on Monday, 21st September, 2026 through Video Conferencing / Other Audio-Visual Means and information related to book closure, record date for dividend, remote e-voting facility of the company and intimation regarding the opening of special window for re-lodgement of transfer request for physical shareholders.

The said copies of the newspaper advertisement are also available on the website of the company i.e., www.mazdalimited.com.

Please take the same on record.
